title: Console Sentinel: route-level delta inspector for canary and A/B rollouts
creator: Ava Chen
description: Add a Console-first inspector ("Sentinel") that surfaces per-route deltas between rollout cohorts (canary vs prod, A vs B, shadow vs live), links traces to request cohorts, and provides one-click policy suggestions for auto-rollback. Focus is on developer workflows: fast triage for metric regressions, root-cause trace correlation, and an action panel for rollbacks or traffic-split adjustments.
acceptance_criteria: UI: New 'Sentinel' tab available in rollout details with cohort selector and time-range control
Metrics: per-route breakdown showing baseline vs candidate for latency (p50/p95), error rate, token cost, and hallucination score (if available)
Diffs: Visual diff view that highlights statistically significant deltas and shows confidence intervals
Tracing: Link from a cohort metric spike to sampled traces filtered by cohort attribution
Actions: One-click 'pause' and 'rollback to previous model' buttons wired to rollout controller with confirmation modal
Telemetry: Events emitted for Sentinel open, cohort-change, action-click, and rollback-complete
Performance: Sentinel renders first meaningful paint within 600ms for routes with <100TPS and supports lazy-loading for heavy cohorts
notes: 2025-02-18 - Created by Ava Chen: initial scoping and motivation; referenced incident on 2025-01-30 where a canary introduced 8% p95 latency regression for /chat-route (see incident-2025-01-30)
2025-02-22 - PM sync: Decided to prioritize route-level breakdowns over endpoint-wide aggregates; backend contract change required (ENG-13221)
2025-02-27 - Design review with Priya: introduced 'DeltaLens' visual which emphasizes % change + absolute severity; Figma mock added (link below)
2025-02-28 - Eng kickoff with Miguel and backend leads: agreed on lazy cohort sampling for traces, telemetry event schema, and RBAC gate for rollback actions (ENG-14400)
2025-03-03 - Spike completed: prototype shows diffs using Bayesian bootstrap yields fewer false positives vs naive t-test; push to use Bayesian thresholding as default (research notes link)
2025-03-04 - UX feedback from SEs: add a 'compare time-shift' control to check upstream infra noise; added to acceptance criteria
design_mocks: Figma: DeltaLens - cohort diff + action panel v2
implementation_steps: Backend: cohort attribution + prefetched summary metrics store; implement Bayesian diffing job (ENG-13221)
Tracing: add cohort tag to sampled traces and sampling policy for canaries (ENG-14400)
Frontend: Sentinel tab and DeltaLens components, cohort selector, diff visualization, trace links, action panel
Auth: RBAC check for rollback/traffic-change actions; only allowed for members of 'Platform Safety' and rollout owners
E2E: integration tests that simulate canary introducing regressions and verify UI flags + rollback flow
risks: False positives on low-traffic routes may trigger unnecessary rollbacks; mitigated by Bayesian thresholds and minimum-sample checks
Adding rollback actions to Console increases blast radius; require RBAC and review logs before GA
Tracing costs could rise if sampling for cohorts is naive; need targeted sampling and TTL for stored samples
qa_plan: Create synthetic workload generator that can inject latency and error regressions into canary cohort
Run visual diff tests against known regression patterns and ensure Sentinel flags them
Verify RBAC prevents unauthorized rollbacks; test audit log entries are created
rollout_plan: Beta: enable for internal orgs and Platform 'dogfood' accounts only (2 weeks)
Controlled GA: opt-in for customers with dedicated capacity and SLO monitoring (4 weeks)
GA: default available to all Console users with advisory docs and recommended playbook
test_cases: TC-001: Canary introduces +20% p95 on /chat-route -> Sentinel highlights metric, traces link shows cohort-specific traces, one-click rollback succeeds
TC-002: Low-traffic route (n=30 reqs) shows no action suggested due to sample threshold
TC-003: A/B test with differing hallucination score -> DeltaLens surfaces qualitative metric and links to eval prompt set
